label: T1 segmentation pipeline
description: A three-step workflow for a T1-weighted head MRI: N4 bias correction, brain extraction and SynthSeg segmentation.
expectedResult: The workflow validates with three steps, one input t1 and two outputs, brain and labels, and can be exported as t1-segmentation.workflow.json.

label: Multi-shell DWI preprocessing pipeline
description: For diffusion data with at least two nonzero b-value shells: denoising, Gibbs removal, motion and distortion correction, brain masking, DTI, NODDI and tractography.
expectedResult: The six-step workflow validates without errors and exports as dwi-preprocessing.workflow.json. Run it on a Neurodesk desktop with hardware WebGPU and subgroups support.
